Dear Treating Doctor,

SHEPHERD, CORY attended the Emergency Department at Gold Coast University Hospital on the
06-Jun-2024 12:30:04.

The diagnosis was Chronic dental pain.

Hospital Course:

Cory presented to ED with dental/gum pain. BG of multiple max facs surgeries related to an old
tooth extraction of tooth 13. Three bone grafts and insertion of plate and mesh. Surgeon had
planned to remove the mesh last year however, Cory did not have the funds for it and had minimal
symptoms at that time so has not gone through with it yet.

For the past 4 weeks he has had increasing pain to his gum which is now radiating up into his
cheek and orbit. Systemically well. Area of mesh now exposed through his gum.

Case was discussed with the maxfacs team who recommended a CT scan tonight and then follow up in
their clinic. Cory did not wish to wait in ED for his CT scan as he has had a long wait in ED
already and has elected to go and see his GP for a CT scan of his face with contrast. He was
commenced on PO augmentin and advised to use a chlorhexidine mouthwash. Given panadeine forte
for analgesia.
